description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.
vibe: Portability is non-negotiable; every shell, every test, every time.
highlights: POSIX-compliant shell scripting across sh, dash, bash, ksh, and zsh
Comprehensive test suite with urchin, covering fast, slow, sourcing, and installation tests
Strict shellcheck linting and EditorConfig compliance enforced in CI
Internal functions prefixed with nvm_ for clear namespace separation
Mock files must only be updated via update_test_mocks.sh script
assessment: This instruction file reflects a deep commitment to portability and reliability, treating shell compatibility as a first-class constraint rather than an afterthought. The emphasis on testing across multiple shells and using dedicated linting tools demonstrates a mature, systems-level engineering discipline that prioritizes correctness over convenience. The clear separation of concerns and detailed function categorization make the codebase navigable even for AI agents.
